tasks.title: Contract 2.0.0 defines lossless admin saves, file status and safe exports
tasks.spec: ## Repository: contract, all Behavior bullets, Checks 1-5 and Completion evidence; Contract fields table; Required behavior 8 and 12-19, 23-25, 33-35 at the schema boundary; Security impact checklist for strict validators, own-data/accessor safety and response redaction. Implement all named sources, keep marker, input/view, file status and export schemas/types/validator and status-order text in the existing admin modules and explicit index exports. Reuse the shared check refinements and header limits; a keep marker contributes 0 literal bytes. Every database view, for all six check types, validates unchanged as input; source accepts database only in input and hasSecret accepts true on heartbeat only. Export checks reject secret, source, hasSecret and markers; redacted, when present, is nonempty. Cover counterexamples 7-15, 18 and 31-33 at schema level. In test/smoke.test.ts, extend the literal runtime export list by exactly ADMIN_CHECK_SOURCES, adminCheckSourceSchema, ADMIN_FILE_STATES, adminFileStatusSchema, adminKeepSchema, adminExportRedactionSchema, adminConfigExportSchema and validateAdminConfigExport; remove no existing name and add no type-only name. Document the applied-file plus database revision, permissions, new shapes, markers and statuses. Set package version to the literal 2.0.0, keep WIRE_VERSION 1 and add no module file. Regenerate and commit only the six listed dist files. If the starting code already has source on check views and keep markers, follow the section's needs-input hold condition. Keep the PULSE_HEADER_ env-name validation unchanged; any sentinel env references must use the corrected fixtures in the current spec. This is one task because schemas, explicit exports, validators, smoke/type fixtures and generated dist must change together to keep the build and round-trip tests green.

acceptance.expected: All tests pass, 0 fail (a focused run may fail the global coverage threshold). Literal cases accept a database view unchanged for every type and reject source file as input, hasSecret on a non-heartbeat, keep false/string/extra keys, state ok with a non-null message, redacted [], and any export check secret or marker. Existing field limits and own-data/accessor protections pass.
All smoke tests pass, 0 fail (a focused run may fail the global coverage threshold). The exact package export-list test and the generated-dist reproducibility test both pass.

acceptance.command: git diff "$(git merge-base origin/main HEAD)" -- test/smoke.test.ts
acceptance.expected: The test package entry exports the validators and the wire version adds exactly the literal names ADMIN_CHECK_SOURCES, adminCheckSourceSchema, ADMIN_FILE_STATES, adminFileStatusSchema, adminKeepSchema, adminExportRedactionSchema, adminConfigExportSchema and validateAdminConfigExport to its expected list, removes none and adds no type-only name. The expected list is written out independently of the entry module being checked.
exit 0; lint, generated build, typecheck including test/types.fixture.ts values of every new type, and the full suite pass with line coverage >= 0.8. No public/probe shape or WIRE_VERSION change.

acceptance.command: bun run build && git diff --exit-code -- dist
acceptance.expected: exit 0 after generated files have been committed; the six specified dist files are reproducible.

acceptance.command: git diff --name-only $(git merge-base origin/main HEAD) HEAD -- src dist
acceptance.expected: The source paths are exactly src/admin.ts, src/validate-admin.ts and src/index.ts; generated changes are confined to dist/admin.js, dist/admin.d.ts, dist/validate-admin.js, dist/validate-admin.d.ts, dist/index.js and dist/index.d.ts. No new module is introduced, preserving status's fixed module list.

acceptance.command: bun -e 'const p = await Bun.file("package.json").json(); if (p.version !== "2.0.0") process.exit(1); const c = await import("./src/index.ts"); if (c.WIRE_VERSION !== 1) process.exit(1);'
acceptance.expected: exit 0; version is the literal 2.0.0 and WIRE_VERSION is the literal 1.

The PR names #565, version 2.0.0, the new exports from Contract fields, actual check results and known compatibility limits. It records review of strict input, exact marker shapes, own-data/accessor safety, unchanged check limits and response/export redaction; no new dependency or contract module.
